description: This file is a shell script used for managing system diagnostics and LED indicators on an OpenWrt device. It includes functions to identify status LEDs and set their states based on system initialization or failure conditions.

methods.name: get_status_led
methods.description: Identifies the relevant status LED device file by searching for specific LED names in /sys/class/leds/

methods.name: set_state
methods.description: Sets the LED state based on the argument indicating system status such as preinit, failsafe, or done.
